gen-irish-grover-fs-synonym: Sturdy, playful lettering that looks grown rather than drawn. Synonym is the quiet one, a sans of constant ink and generous openings, so Irish Grover can show off its tall lowercase.
gen-irish-grover-gf-aclonica: Tall lowercase makes Irish Grover look sturdy and oversized, with softly varied strokes. Aclonica, a plain sans, stretches out in widely spaced lines with a deep midsection, so the two feel stacked tall over long.
gen-irish-grover-gf-allerta: A faint pull between heavy verticals and lighter horizontals gives Irish Grover its fun, organic character. And Allerta, a plain sans with wide, loose tracking and a prominent x-height, can go a touch smaller without losing legibility.
gen-irish-grover-gf-alumni-sans: Short ascenders and a wide-open c give the body text a compact, approachable read. Alumni Sans does the understated work as sans-serif text, while Irish Grover is best at big, sturdy, organic display lettering.
gen-irish-grover-gf-alumni-sans-pinstrip: Irish Grover sets tall, sturdy lowercase with a gentle swing between heavier and lighter strokes that feel fun and organic. Alumni Sans Pinstripe, a plain sans, keeps one line weight and tight word texture.
gen-irish-grover-gf-alumni-sans-sc: Alumni Sans SC is a plain sans whose lowercase looks oversized beside its own capitals, with a squeezed fit between letters. But Irish Grover brings the fun, with tall, sturdy lowercase and softly varied strokes.
gen-irish-grover-gf-anaheim: Dense, modern and approachable, Anaheim is a sans-serif whose rounded forms stay open to the side. And because Irish Grover carries the fun up top, Anaheim can stay modest in size.
gen-irish-grover-gf-arsenal: Irish Grover has tall lowercase that makes words look sturdy, with open throats and a fun, organic feel. And Arsenal, a sans with an x-height near its cap height, looks right at a modest size beside it.
gen-irish-grover-gf-arsenal-sc: Arsenal SC is a plain sans with a faint but real thick-thin shift. Its tight fit and wide mouths can be sized down, leaving Irish Grover to carry the fun with its tall, sturdy lowercase.
gen-irish-grover-gf-asimovian: Strokes that shift weight like gently tapered glass rods give Irish Grover its sturdy, organic look. And Asimovian, a plain sans traced at a single stylus width, can be sized a little smaller.
